meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Hidden Forge Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover stolen alloy blueprints from the Hidden Forge without alerting the Overseer AI.
improvisation_points: Obtain encryption keys from Krel-Beta in Smelter's Gulch.
Use Flux-Prime's hum to jam the sensors in the Kinetic Piston.
Deliver the blueprints to Overseer-Alpha to bypass the lockdown.

quests.title: Nexus Slag Deactivation
quests.narrative_guidance: Deactivate a volatile slag pocket threatening the Furnace Nexus.
improvisation_points: Consult Voss-Steel for the deactivation sequence in Basalt Maw.
Escort Dray-Heat through the thermal vents of Pressure Chamber 04.
Submit the stabilized core to Forge-Unit-9 in Slag Descent.

quests.title: Experimental Sintering Escort
quests.narrative_guidance: Escort a shipment to the Sintering Pits for experimental alloy testing.
improvisation_points: Meet Smelter-Shadow at Anvil Reach to collect the experimental core.
Pass through the Vitreous Archive by bribing Krel-Archivist with data.
Secure the delivery with Flux-Filter in the Carbon Filter Spires.

quests.title: The Phantom Core Chase
quests.narrative_guidance: Track the Phantom Smelter through molten channels to recover stolen cores.
improvisation_points: Analyze heat distortions with Overseer-Theta in Cooling Vent Theta.
Follow the secret symbols left by Voss-Gamma in Geodesic Dome Alpha.
Corner the phantom using Dray-Glass's sonar in the Polishing Flats.

quests.title: Mapping the Void Routes
quests.narrative_guidance: Assist in mapping new tunnel routes to optimize extraction efficiency.
improvisation_points: Collect topographical data from Forge-Unit-X in the Refractive Gallery.
Identify thermal weak points with Smelter-Ghost in the Data-Chiseled Halls.
Deliver the finalized map to Krel-Soot in the Soot-Home Blocks.

quests.title: Plasma Conduit Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Sabotage a rival foundry's plasma conduits to delay production.
improvisation_points: Acquire the jamming device from Flux-Spark at the Radiant Hearth.
Infiltrate the Ash-Gardens under the guidance of Overseer-Ash.
Overload the conduits at Sulfur Springs with Voss-Acid.

quests.title: The Pre-Syndicate Retrieval
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate the Maintenance Conclave to retrieve pre-Syndicate machinery schematics.
improvisation_points: Gain entry codes from Dray-Silt in the Low-Vent Shallows.
Trade alloy samples for information with Forge-Unit-8 at the Tallow Market.
Store the schematics safely with Smelter-Void in the Breath-Safe Vaults.

quests.title: The Blueprint Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover stolen alloy blueprints from a hidden forge before the AI detects the breach.
improvisation_points: Infiltrate the Piston Plinth and obtain the location from Foreman Krel-Alpha.
Meet Engineer Voss-Glass in Vitreous Reach to decode the blueprint encryption.
Deliver the decrypted files to Flux-Delta in the Iron-Gut Deep for secure storage.

quests.title: Slag Pocket Suppression
quests.narrative_guidance: A volatile slag pocket is threatening the furnace nexus and must be deactivated immediately.
improvisation_points: Receive the emergency coordinates from Overseer AI-Thermal on the Magma-Tap Terrace.
Obtain a specialized cooling core from Blacksmith AI-Forge in Cinder-Gait Hub.
Install the core at the Slag-Flow Bypass under the supervision of Foreman Krel-Sigma.

quests.title: The Sintering Escort
quests.narrative_guidance: Escort a renegade engineer to a dangerous testing site for experimental alloy trials.
improvisation_points: Meet Engineer Voss-Seven in the Steam-Hiss Conduits to begin the journey.
Navigate the dangerous Fiber-Weave Vaults with Scout Dray-Vitreous to avoid detection.
Complete the alloy test and deliver the results to Flux-Prime in the Rapid-Rail Arteries.

quests.title: Wraith of the Molten Canyon
quests.narrative_guidance: Track the mysterious Phantom Smelter to recover stolen power cores.
improvisation_points: Analyze the heat distortion patterns with Blacksmith AI-Marrow in the Sulfur-Mist Vents.
Confront the Phantom Smelter-Cinder in the Gear-Grind Plaza to reclaim the first batch of cores.
Secure the remaining cores with Overseer AI-Vision in the Cooling Coils.

quests.title: Optimal Extraction Route
quests.narrative_guidance: Map new tunnel routes to increase the efficiency of raw material extraction.
improvisation_points: Begin the mapping mission with Scout Dray-Deep at Tectonic Anchor 09.
Bypass security protocols in the Rapid-Rail Arteries using Flux-Prime's interference field.
Submit the finalized maps to Foreman Krel-Beta at the Prism-Light Labs.

quests.title: Foundry Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Delay a rival's production by sabotaging their plasma conduits.
improvisation_points: Receive the sabotage target data from Overseer AI-Logic in the Hub.
Modify the sabotage tools with Engineer Voss-Iron in the Anvil Heart.
Plant the device and escape via Bolt-Tight Alley with the help of Scout Dray-One.

quests.title: Pre-Syndicate Schematics
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate the conclave to retrieve ancient machinery designs.
improvisation_points: Obtain the entry codes from Flux-Delta in the Iron-Gut Deep.
Retrieve the hidden data chips from Blacksmith AI-Mirror in the Translucent Tunnels.
Deliver the schematics to The Phantom Smelter-Prime in the Ore-Crush Canyon for safe keeping.

quests.title: The Blueprints of the Hidden Forge
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover stolen alloy blueprints from a hidden compartment without triggering the Overseer AI's alarm.
improvisation_points: Obtain the location codes from Foreman Krel in Magma-Throne.
Intercept the decryption key from Engineer Tavis in the Vent-Spire.
Deliver the blueprints to Forge-Master AI-11 for integration.

quests.title: Slag Pocket Neutralization
quests.narrative_guidance: A volatile pocket of slag is threatening the foundation of the Delta. Deactivate it immediately.
improvisation_points: Consult Scout Dray for the precise thermal coordinates.
Use Flux-02 to disrupt the pressure sensors around the pocket.
Request Logic-Unit Gamma to initiate a controlled quench.

quests.title: The Renegade's Escort
quests.narrative_guidance: Engineer Voss must reach the sintering pits for an experiment, but his secret symbols have made him a target.
improvisation_points: Secure authorization from Logic-Unit Alpha.
Meet Scout Lyra to navigate through the vapor cover.
Deliver Voss safely to Engineer Kael's stamping row.

quests.title: Tracking the Phantom
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover stolen alloy cores by following the trail of heat distortion across the Syncline.
improvisation_points: Observe the heat patterns with The Sintering Ghost.
Triangulate the phantom's pulse with Forge-Master AI-10.
Ambush the entity with Scout Silas in the quench-pools.

quests.title: Mapping the Dark Tunnels
quests.narrative_guidance: The extraction routes are outdated. Assist the scouts in establishing a new thermal grid.
improvisation_points: Deploy Flux-01 to plant signal repeaters.
Verify the atmospheric pressure with Logic-Unit Beta.
Confirm the final route with The Grid Phantom.

quests.title: Plasma Sabotage Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: A rival foundry is outpacing production. Delay them by sabotaging their plasma conduits.
improvisation_points: Receive the sabotage schedule from Forge-Master AI-9.
Procure the necessary tools from Foreman Jarek.
Execute the cut and escape through Foreman Zale's commons.

quests.title: The Pre-Syndicate Schematics
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate the Maintenance Conclave to retrieve ancient machinery schematics lost to time.
improvisation_points: Accept the mission from Engineer Voss.
Gain entry using the heat-masking technique of The Vapor Phantom.
Extract the data via Flux-03's encrypted frequency.
